scenario_name: Synthetic VLAN30 to VLAN20 SYN reconnaissance

evidence_items.command: capinfos docs/evidence/pcaps/recon_vlan30_to_vlan20.pcap; tshark -r docs/evidence/pcaps/recon_vlan30_to_vlan20.pcap -T fields -e frame.number -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e tcp.srcport -e tcp.dstport -e tcp.flags
evidence_items.expected_result: At least eight qualifying SYN packets in ten seconds trigger the Suricata rule
evidence_items.actual_result: One intact TCP SYN packet from 10.10.30.5:54321 to 10.10.20.15:22 was parsed
evidence_items.limitations: A one-packet test vector cannot cross the detection threshold and does not prove a scan, alert or firewall action.

evidence_items.expected_result: Wazuh rule 100010 matches a Suricata EVE alert for SID 1000001
evidence_items.limitations: This is not Wazuh-emitted output and does not demonstrate decoder, rule or manager operation.
